terms: Professional commercial driver included in every rental package.
Tolls, state entry permits, taxes and parking fees are charged on actuals.
One day package covers up to 300 KM per day.
KM reading is counted from parking to parking (garage to garage).
Night halt allowance (₹700) applies for journeys crossing 11:00 PM.
Air-conditioned coaches maintain optimal cooling throughout the route.
notes: Prices shown are per-KM rates. All rates exclude Toll, TP, Tax and Parking. Final quotation is confirmed upon route review and date availability.
